title: Video Language Planning
layout_note: a central framed tree-search panel flanked by four unframed component panels (two left, two right), each tied to the tree element it produces by a dashed coloured callout
grouping: One large rounded grey-outlined central panel titled 'Video Language Planning' holds the search tree and, at its bottom, a lavender strip 'Execute plan from tree search'. Left of it, two unframed component blocks ('VLM as Text Policies', 'VLM as Heuristic Functions'); right of it, 'Video Model as Dynamics Model', 'Actions from Goal-Conditioned Policies' and an 'Experiments across Multiple Robots' photo pair. Component headings are colour-coded and each has a grey subtitle giving its input and output.
shapes_depth: Flat, soft pastel style: light-blue rounded boxes for PaLM-E and for text-action pills, a light-orange box for Text-to-Video, a lavender box and bars for Policies; tree nodes are stacks of overlapping real tabletop photos on orange-tinted cards; rounded progress bars (green, yellow, red) under each node; a person icon in a grey pill for the instruction.
proposed_highlight: The method name is the title, with the word 'Video' in orange and 'Language' in blue, the same hues as the video-model and VLM components; the search tree occupies the large centre and a pruned branch is faded with a red cross.
lesson: Put the search procedure in a large central frame and the components that drive it in side panels whose heading colour is carried onto the tree elements they produce, joined by dashed callouts of that colour.
notes: Method short name VLP (used in the caption). venue: unverified (the fetched PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint with no venue footer); remembered as ICLR 2024. year = arXiv preprint year. The photos are embedded rasters recorded by refs crop.

arrangement.units: one rounded grey-outlined centre panel (tree search plus an execution strip in a lavender band) and five unframed side blocks separated by whitespace and coloured headings
arrangement.inputs_as: a real tabletop photo and a quoted instruction in a pill with a person icon ('make a horizontal line of blocks')
arrangement.losses_at: none; the heuristic score is a progress bar under each tree node
arrangement.shared: PaLM-E appears twice (as text policy and as heuristic), drawn as two identical light-blue boxes in two side blocks

taxonomy.task: long-horizon robot planning by tree search over VLM-proposed subgoals and video-model rollouts
taxonomy.note: training other: the figure shows inference-time planning only; no training objective is drawn

insights.structure: The search tree is the centre and largest element; the four components that make it work sit around it as side panels, each with a heading, an 'input -> output' subtitle and one worked example.
insights.data: Every tree node is a stack of real video frames on an orange card, text actions are quoted in blue pills, and the heuristic is a progress bar with its value ('28 steps left') written out.
insights.emphasis: Colour does the emphasis: the title words 'Video' and 'Language' share the orange and blue of the video-model and VLM panels, and a faded branch with a red cross shows pruning.
insights.flow: Inside the frame the tree reads top to bottom (instruction and image, two candidate steps, re-plan, execute strip); dashed callouts in the component's colour run from each side panel to the tree element it produces.
insights.avoid: The 'Experiments across Multiple Robots' photo pair puts results inside the method figure, and the traffic-light progress bars add a third use of green and red next to the green check and red cross.

core.what: a branching search tree in the centre frame: candidate steps as video-frame stacks, scored by bars, the best expanded again and the losing branch faded

relations.form: two levels of tree expansion top to bottom, each node a stack of frames with a score bar, the pruned node faded with a red cross, then a lavender execution strip
four side panels each explain one tree ingredient, tied to its element in the tree by a dashed callout in the component's colour
the same PaLM-E model is drawn as two identical light-blue boxes in the text-policy and heuristic panels

channels.colour: blue = VLM outputs (PaLM-E, text-action pills, tree step labels), orange = video model (Text-to-Video box, node cards), lavender = policies and execution; green/yellow/red = heuristic score level on the bars; green and red reappear as check mark and cross
channels.shape: rounded box = model, pill = text, stacked photos = video rollout, rounded bar = score
channels.line: grey solid lines = tree edges; coloured dashed elbow lines = 'this component produces that element'; short blue solid arrows inside side panels = input to output
channels.frame: the rounded grey frame encloses the method itself; side blocks are unframed

quality.strengths: The core tree search is drawn as an actual tree of real frame stacks with a faded pruned branch, the largest thing in the figure; component colour is keyed by the headings and the title itself and carried onto the tree elements; data are real photos and quoted actions; each side panel states its input -> output.
quality.weaknesses: The dashed callouts are long elbow lines crossing whitespace into the frame; green and red carry both score level and success/failure; a results panel (experiments on multiple robots) shares the space with the method; text in the step pills is truncated with ellipses.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
